name: Lineuparr
description: Mirror real-world provider channel lineups by creating channel groups, channels, and fuzzy-matching IPTV streams to them.
author: PiratesIRC
_fields_note: Settings fields are defined dynamically by the Plugin.fields property in plugin.py (the single source of truth : it builds live dropdowns for lineups, M3U/EPG sources and profiles). Dispatcharr only falls back to a manifest 'fields' array when the plugin provides none, so it is intentionally omitted here to prevent drift.

actions.label: Validate Settings
actions.description: Check all settings, show lineup summary and available profiles

actions.label: Show Status
actions.description: Show progress of the current operation, or the result of the last one, without checking the logs

actions.label: Preview Stream Match
actions.description: Dry run. Shows which stream would attach to each lineup channel and how confidently, and writes a CSV export and an HTML report. Changes no channel, stream or guide.

actions.label: Full Sync
actions.description: Every step in one run: create groups and channels from the lineup, match streams, assign guides and logos, and enable the channels in your profile. Unless Preserve Existing Streams is on, the stream matching step replaces each channel's whole stream list and then deletes any channel left with no streams.

confirm.message: Full Sync creates groups and channels, matches streams, assigns guides and logos, and enables the channels in your profile. Unless Preserve Existing Streams is on, it also REPLACES each channel's existing stream list and DELETES channels left with no streams. Continue?

actions.label: Sync Channels Only
actions.description: Creates and updates the channel groups and channels the lineup describes. Adds and renumbers only; it matches no streams and deletes nothing.

confirm.message: This will create groups and channels from the lineup. Continue?

actions.label: Apply Stream Match Only
actions.description: Attaches matched streams to channels that already exist, in quality order. Unless Preserve Existing Streams is on, it replaces each channel's whole stream list rather than adding to it, and then deletes any channel left with no streams.

confirm.message: This attaches matched streams to your channels. Unless Preserve Existing Streams is on, it REPLACES each channel's existing stream list and DELETES channels left with no streams. Continue?

actions.label: Apply EPG Match
actions.description: Matches guide entries to your channels and assigns the programme guide. A channel that already has a guide is left alone, so this adds and never replaces.

confirm.message: This will assign EPG data to Lineuparr-managed channels. Continue?

actions.label: Assign Logos
actions.description: Assigns a logo to each channel, taken from the guide entry's icon, the Logo Manager, or the tv-logos repository on GitHub, in that order. Sets a logo where there is none and removes none.

confirm.message: This will assign logos to channels that don't have one. Continue?

actions.label: Re-sort Streams by Quality
actions.description: Re-orders the streams a channel already has, using the newest quality data. Run it after IPTV Checker has scanned your streams so the order uses measured resolution rather than the quality tag in the name. It changes the order only; no stream is added or removed.

actions.label: Clear CSV Exports
actions.description: Deletes every lineuparr_*.csv file in /data/exports, however new. It touches no channel, stream or guide, and ignores the Delete CSV Exports Older Than setting.

confirm.message: Delete every Lineuparr CSV export in /data/exports? Your channels, streams and guides are not affected.

actions.label: Email Report Now
actions.description: Sends the newest report already on disk to Newsflasharr for delivery. It does not re-run a match, so the report is as old as the last run that produced one.
